Liam (CEO): Quick reminder: all-hands Friday 10:00am PT in Main. Plan ~30 min. Drop one question by Thu EOD.

Priya (VP Product): Agenda: 1) Exec update + hiring snapshot (Liam) 2) Launch callouts: region fallback + canary windows (Priya/Marco) 3) Policy update: dev log retention & prompt redaction (Nora/Elena) 4) Incident summary (SRE) 5) Q&A.

Nora (CTO): Policy tease: default hosted dev logs -> 90 days; optional prompt redaction will be demoed. Dedicated customers can set retention via contract.

Elena (SRE): Incident TL;DR: brief routing mismatch during a canary caused elevated 5xx in one AZ for ~15m. No customer data exposure. Postmortem in #postmortems; TL;DR and mitigations in slides.

ops-bot: Reminder: upload demo slides if requesting a slot by Thu 8pm PT.

(After meeting)

ops-bot: Recording + slides posted: https://redwood.internal/recordings/allhands-2622222222-2026-11-12.mp4 | https://redwood.internal/allhands/nov-2026-slides.pdf

Liam (CEO): Thanks all. Takeaways: hiring focus on infra, region-fallback rollout next week, policy defaults set, incident mitigations implemented.

Priya (VP Product): Actions: Eng leads post rollout windows in #eng-releases by Mon; Security publish FAQ by Thu; SRE finalize postmortem tickets.

Nora (CTO): If your question wasn't answered live, DM me or Priya and we'll follow up.

Elena (SRE): Customer blurb approved: "We briefly impacted request availability for a subset of users during an internal canary. No customer data was exposed. Mitigations have been deployed."

Liam (CEO): Closing: next all-hands in 6 weeks. Thanks for joining. :clap:
